description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_CompileAllTemplates', which provides methods for compiling all templates and configuration files in a Smarty templating system. It includes functionality to search through directories, compile templates, and handle errors.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_CompileAllTemplates
classes.description: Class providing methods to compile all templates and configuration files within the Smarty templating framework, handling directory and file iteration, compile checks, and error management.

methods.name: compileAllTemplates

methods.name: compileAll
methods.description: Protected method that performs the core logic for compiling either all templates or config files, iterating over directories and handling each file accordingly.
